scientific_integrity: Analytic all-size proof of conditional mean, sign threshold, and mixed covariance. Exact finite enumerations are supplementary. No claim of independent validation or exhaustive historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Uniform recursive-tree attachment only, unconditional tree law except for a single specified parent choice. Does not prove conditional distributions, pathwise monotonicity, or absolute novelty.
title: An age threshold for Wiener-index response in uniform random recursive trees
